name: Curly Termite 88
author: Yaseen549
description: Dark gray button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks: While pressed, box-shadow becomes 0px 2px 0px #787878, top becomes 2px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Curly Termite 88</title>
<style>
/* Curly Termite 88 by Yaseen549 — https://uiverse.io/Yaseen549/curly-termite-88 */
.button {
 color: #ecf0f1;
 font-size: 17px;
 background-color: #212121;
 border: 1px solid #ffffff;
 border-radius: 5px;
 padding: 10px;
 box-shadow: 0px 6px 0px #787878;
 transition: all 50ms;
 width: 120px;
}

.button:active {
 box-shadow: 0px 2px 0px #787878;
 position: relative;
 top: 2px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button"> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
